License

This FAST (Faceted Application of Subject Terminology) data files are made available by OCLC under the Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By): https://www.oclc.org/research/activities/fast/odcby.html.

The License allows the data to be used for study and research, among other things, with attribution in works produced from the database. The plain language summary of the License can be read here.

FAST (Faceted Application of Subject Terminology) Data ODC-BY license

Attribution

We'd be glad if you attributed us like this:

This [title of report or article or dataset] contains information from FAST (Faceted Application of Subject Terminology) Data which is made available by OCLC Online Computer Library Center, Inc. under the ODC Attribution License.

If including implicit links isn't possible, links can be included explicitly:

This [title of report or article or dataset] contains information from FAST (Faceted Application of Subject Terminology) Data (http://www.oclc.org/research/activities/fast/datafiles.htm) which is made available by OCLC Online Computer Library Center, Inc. under the ODC Attribution License (http://www.oclc.org/research/activities/fast/odcby.htm).
